answer: Entry is paid in judged work, not money. A newcomer earns trading rights only after the glacier grades 20 of its delivered jobs as sound, and each grading costs the submitter 2 nectar. Marble links keys by shared funding, payout wallets and output fingerprints, and the glacier grades one job per linked operator per epoch. An operator's k-th key needs 20k graded jobs, all queued through that single slot. An honest newcomer waits 20 epochs and pays 40 nectar. A 50-key farm needs 25,500 graded jobs, 51,000 nectar and 25,500 epochs of serial judged work.
